//go:build js && wasm && !nextgo_module

package client

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"syscall/js"
	"testing"
)

func TestOfflineDisableRefusalPreservesLatestConfirmedState(t *testing.T) {
	for _, statusKind := range []string{"ready", "corrupt", "failed", "busy", "unsupported"} {
		t.Run(statusKind, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			f.c.state.Enabled = true
			f.c.state.CleanupPending = true
			f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			f.c.state.WaitingGeneration = strings.Repeat("b", 64)
			old := f.respond
			f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
				reply := old(request)
				if request.Command == "status" {
					switch statusKind {
					case "ready":
						reply.State, reply.Enabled = "ready", true
						reply.ActiveGeneration = reply.Generation
					case "corrupt":
						reply.State, reply.Error = "failed", "corrupt-storage"
					case "failed":
						reply.State = "failed"
					case "busy":
						reply.State = "busy"
					case "unsupported":
						reply.Supported = false
					}
					return reply
				}
				reply.State, reply.Enabled, reply.Error = "disabled", false, "client-capacity"
				reply.DeferredCleanup = false
				reply.ActiveGeneration = ""
				return reply
			}
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("worker refusal was accepted")
			}
			state := OfflineStatus()
			if !state.Enabled || f.c.confirmedDisabled || !offlineNativeNavigation() || f.unregisters != 0 || f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged {
				t.Fatalf("default false refusal changed enabled/navigation/commit truth: %+v", state)
			}
			if statusKind == "ready" {
				if state.ActiveGeneration != strings.Repeat("e", 64) || state.CleanupPending || state.WaitingGeneration != "" {
					t.Fatalf("newer successfully confirmed status was discarded: %+v", state)
				}
			} else if state.ActiveGeneration != strings.Repeat("a", 64) || !state.CleanupPending || state.WaitingGeneration != strings.Repeat("b", 64) {
				t.Fatalf("unconfirmed status overwrote previous knowledge: %+v", state)
			}
			wantCommands := 2
			if statusKind == "unsupported" {
				wantCommands = 1
			}
			if len(f.commands) != wantCommands || f.registers != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("refusal retried or registered: %+v", f.commands)
			}
			f.balanced(t)
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineDisableControlMustAcknowledgeDisabled(t *testing.T) {
	for _, state := range []string{"failed", "busy", "staged"} {
		t.Run(state, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			old := f.respond
			f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
				r := old(request)
				if request.Command == "status" {
					r.Enabled, r.State, r.ActiveGeneration = true, "ready", r.Generation
				} else {
					r.State = state
				}
				return r
			}
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineProtocol) {
				t.Fatal("non-disabled control result was accepted", err)
			}
			if !OfflineStatus().Enabled || f.c.confirmedDisabled || f.unregisters != 0 || f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged {
				t.Fatal("failed/busy/staged reply published Disabled or unregistered")
			}
			f.balanced(t)
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineDisableSuccessfulCommitSurvivesUnregisterFailure(t *testing.T) {
	for _, failure := range []string{"rejected", "false"} {
		t.Run(failure, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			f.registration.Set("unregister", f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any {
				f.unregisters++
				if failure == "rejected" {
					return js.Global().Get("Promise").Call("reject", js.Global().Get("Error").New("native refusal"))
				}
				return f.resolve(false)
			}))
			if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("failed unregister claimed full completion")
			}
			state := OfflineStatus()
			if state.Enabled || !state.CleanupPending || !f.c.confirmedDisabled || state.ActiveGeneration == "" || f.unregisters != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("known successful Disable was rolled back after unregister failure: %+v", state)
			}
			if !f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !f.c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || f.c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue {
				t.Fatalf("partial receipt is not truthful: %+v", f.c.lastDisable)
			}
			f.balanced(t)
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineDisableCorruptStatusSuppliesIdentityWithoutPublishingFalse(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
	f.c.state.Enabled = true
	f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	old := f.respond
	f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
		reply := old(request)
		if request.Command == "status" {
			reply.State, reply.Error = "failed", "corrupt-storage"
		} else if !f.c.state.Enabled || f.c.confirmedDisabled {
			t.Error("errored pre-status published its default false before explicit Disable")
		}
		return reply
	}
	if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("explicit corrupt-storage recovery lost authenticated identity", err)
	}
	if len(f.commands) != 2 || f.commands[1].Command != "disable" || f.commands[1].RuntimeID != strings.Repeat("c", 20) || f.commands[1].ConfigurationID != strings.Repeat("d", 64) || f.unregisters != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("cleanup did not bind actual status identity exactly once: %+v", f.commands)
	}
	if OfflineStatus().Enabled || !f.c.confirmedDisabled || !f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged {
		t.Fatal("successful explicit Disable was not confirmed")
	}
	f.balanced(t)
}

func TestOfflineUnsupportedDisableControlPreservesConfirmedState(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
	old := f.respond
	f.respond = func(request offlineRequest) offlineReply {
		reply := old(request)
		if request.Command == "status" {
			reply.Enabled, reply.State, reply.ActiveGeneration = true, "ready", reply.Generation
		} else {
			reply.Supported, reply.Enabled, reply.State = false, false, "disabled"
			reply.DeferredCleanup = false
			reply.ActiveGeneration = ""
		}
		return reply
	}
	if err := DisableOffline(context.Background()); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnsupported) {
		t.Fatal("unsupported control claimed successful Disable", err)
	}
	if !OfflineStatus().Enabled || f.c.confirmedDisabled || f.unregisters != 0 || f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !offlineNativeNavigation() {
		t.Fatal("unsupported default false overwrote confirmed enabled/navigation state")
	}
	f.balanced(t)
}

func TestOfflineEmptyDisableSelectionIsSeparateAndRequiresStableControl(t *testing.T) {
	for _, use := range []offlineRegistrationUse{offlineRegistrationStrict, offlineRegistrationMutation, offlineRegistrationStatus, offlineRegistrationUpdate, offlineRegistrationDisable} {
		t.Run(string(rune('0'+use)), func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			empty := js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"scope": f.c.descriptor.Scope, "active": js.Null(), "waiting": js.Null(), "installing": js.Null()})
			f.registrations = []js.Value{empty}
			f.sw.Set("getRegistration", f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any { return f.resolve(empty) }))
			selection, err := f.c.registrationForOperation(context.Background(), use)
			switch use {
			case offlineRegistrationDisable:
				if err != nil || !selection.emptyDisable || selection.emptyUpdate || selection.registration.Truthy() || !selection.parentController.Equal(f.worker) {
					t.Fatal("Disable did not receive its own non-authoritative selection", err)
				}
			case offlineRegistrationUpdate:
				if err != nil || !selection.emptyUpdate || selection.emptyDisable || selection.registration.Truthy() {
					t.Fatal("UPDATE selection changed", err)
				}
			case offlineRegistrationStatus:
				if err != nil || selection.emptyDisable || selection.emptyUpdate || !selection.statusWorker.Equal(f.worker) {
					t.Fatal("status gained mutation authority", err)
				}
			default:
				if !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineConflict) || selection.emptyDisable || selection.emptyUpdate {
					t.Fatal("strict or Enable mutation consumed empty lookup", err)
				}
			}
			if len(f.commands) != 0 || f.registers != 0 || f.unregisters != 0 || f.updates != 0 {
				t.Fatal("selection itself performed mutation")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineEmptyDisableSelectionRejectsFinalForeignAndChangedController(t *testing.T) {
	for _, change := range []string{"foreign", "controller", "missing", "duplicate"} {
		t.Run(change, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			empty := js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"scope": f.c.descriptor.Scope, "active": js.Null(), "waiting": js.Null(), "installing": js.Null()})
			f.registrations = []js.Value{empty}
			f.sw.Set("getRegistration", f.fn(func(js.Value, []js.Value) any {
				switch change {
				case "foreign":
					f.registrations = append(f.registrations, js.ValueOf(map[string]any{"scope": f.c.descriptor.Scope + "/foreign", "active": map[string]any{"scriptURL": "https://reader.test/foreign.js"}}))
				case "controller":
					f.sw.Set("controller", js.Null())
				case "missing":
					f.registrations = nil
				case "duplicate":
					f.registrations = append(f.registrations, empty)
				}
				return f.resolve(empty)
			}))
			selection, err := f.c.registrationForOperation(context.Background(), offlineRegistrationDisable)
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineConflict) || selection.emptyDisable || len(f.commands) != 0 || f.unregisters != 0 {
				t.Fatal("degraded final parent proof granted recovery", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineControlRequestCounterNeverWraps(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.c.request = ^uint64(0)
	if _, err := f.c.message(context.Background(), f.worker, "disable", f.c.descriptor.RuntimeID, f.c.descriptor.ConfigurationID); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineProtocol) {
		t.Fatal("request identity wrapped", err)
	}
	if len(f.commands) != 0 || f.channels.Get("created").Int() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("exhausted identity created a port or dispatched a command")
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableRefusalKeepsNewestConfirmedStatus(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
	f.c.state.Enabled = false
	f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	f.c.confirmedDisabled = true
	status := f.respond(offlineRequest{Command: "status"})
	status.State, status.Enabled, status.ActiveGeneration = "ready", true, status.Generation
	result := offlineFreshDisableResult{
		confirmedStatus: status, hasConfirmedStatus: true,
		parent: offlineRealmParent{c: f.c, descriptor: f.c.descriptor, document: doc, window: win, container: f.sw, controller: f.worker, origin: "https://reader.test"},
	}
	if err := f.c.completeFreshDisable(context.Background(), result, ErrOfflineUnknown); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
		t.Fatal("control refusal lost its unconfirmed outcome", err)
	}
	if state := OfflineStatus(); !state.Enabled || state.ActiveGeneration != status.Generation || f.c.confirmedDisabled || !offlineNativeNavigation() || f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged {
		t.Fatalf("fresh status proved enabled, but stale Disabled knowledge survived refusal: %+v", state)
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUnconfirmedStatusAndRevocationCannotPublish(t *testing.T) {
	for _, condition := range []string{"errored", "bad-confirmed-flag", "canceled", "replaced"} {
		t.Run(condition, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
			f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
			f.c.state.Enabled = true
			f.c.state.CleanupPending = true
			f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
			f.c.state.WaitingGeneration = strings.Repeat("b", 64)
			status := f.respond(offlineRequest{Command: "status"})
			status.Error = "corrupt-storage"
			result := offlineFreshDisableResult{
				confirmedStatus: status,
				parent:          offlineRealmParent{c: f.c, descriptor: f.c.descriptor, document: doc, window: win, container: f.sw, controller: f.worker, origin: "https://reader.test"},
			}
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			defer cancel()
			switch condition {
			case "bad-confirmed-flag":
				result.hasConfirmedStatus = true
			case "canceled", "replaced":
				status.Error = ""
				result.confirmedStatus, result.hasConfirmedStatus = status, true
				result.status, result.disableAcknowledged = status, true
				if condition == "canceled" {
					cancel()
				} else {
					documentOffline = &offlineController{}
				}
			}
			if err := f.c.completeFreshDisable(ctx, result, ErrOfflineUnknown); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("unconfirmed/revoked recovery claimed completion")
			}
			state := f.c.state
			if !state.Enabled || !state.CleanupPending || state.ActiveGeneration != strings.Repeat("a", 64) || state.WaitingGeneration != strings.Repeat("b", 64) || f.c.confirmedDisabled {
				t.Fatalf("unconfirmed or revoked status/ACK was published: %+v", state)
			}
			if (condition == "canceled" || condition == "replaced") && !f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged {
				t.Fatal("late authentic ACK was not retained privately")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableAcknowledgementSupersedesConfirmedStatusOnPartialUnregister(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
	status := f.respond(offlineRequest{Command: "status"})
	status.State, status.Enabled, status.ActiveGeneration = "ready", true, status.Generation
	ack := f.respond(offlineRequest{Command: "disable"})
	result := offlineFreshDisableResult{
		confirmedStatus: status, hasConfirmedStatus: true,
		status: ack, disableAcknowledged: true, unregisterAttempted: true,
		parent: offlineRealmParent{c: f.c, descriptor: f.c.descriptor, document: doc, window: win, container: f.sw, controller: f.worker, origin: "https://reader.test"},
	}
	if err := f.c.completeFreshDisable(context.Background(), result, ErrOfflineUnknown); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
		t.Fatal("partial unregister was reported successful", err)
	}
	if state := OfflineStatus(); state.Enabled || !state.CleanupPending || !f.c.confirmedDisabled || state.ActiveGeneration != ack.ActiveGeneration {
		t.Fatalf("successful Disable did not supersede earlier ready status: %+v", state)
	}
	if !f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !f.c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || f.c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || f.c.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		t.Fatalf("fresh partial receipt is not truthful: %+v", f.c.lastDisable)
	}
}

func TestOfflineFreshDisableUnknownCompletionRetainsAlreadyObservedNativeFacts(t *testing.T) {
	f := offlineBrowserFixture(t)
	f.sw.Set("controller", f.worker)
	f.c.state.Enabled = true
	f.c.state.ActiveGeneration = strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	// Model facts retained by this attempt's owned callbacks after possible host
	// delivery. A result with no portable status cannot publish them, or erase
	// them merely because its synchronous observation returned Unknown first.
	f.c.lastDisable = offlineDisableReceipt{disableAcknowledged: true, unregisterAttempted: true, unregisterResolvedTrue: true}
	if err := f.c.completeFreshDisable(context.Background(), offlineFreshDisableResult{}, ErrOfflineUnknown); !errors.Is(err, ErrOfflineUnknown) {
		t.Fatal("unknown native observation claimed completion", err)
	}
	if !f.c.lastDisable.disableAcknowledged || !f.c.lastDisable.unregisterAttempted || !f.c.lastDisable.unregisterResolvedTrue || f.c.lastDisable.verifiedRegistryAbsent {
		t.Fatalf("completion erased late native truth or invented registry absence: %+v", f.c.lastDisable)
	}
	if state := OfflineStatus(); !state.Enabled || state.ActiveGeneration != strings.Repeat("a", 64) || f.c.confirmedDisabled {
		t.Fatalf("private late native receipt was published without status/current authority: %+v", state)
	}
}
